route: SCIE applied prediction and empirical validation
research_question: Does selecting later financial statement vintages change model comparisons and calibration for rare, independently dated corporate bankruptcy events?

required: historically defined risk set, independent of later survival and bankruptcy outcomes
documented BRD event coverage and parent-subsidiary CIK mapping
ascertained non-events or precisely limited registry-event estimand
accession-linked financial values with identical concept, unit, start and end across paired vintages
complete follow-up and a defensible training label-availability rule
data_gate.reason: Current fixed sample contains positive cases only; it is an access audit, not a prediction cohort.

primary_comparison.unit: annual filing landmark; enterprise group dependence retained
primary_comparison.decision_time: day after actual filingDate; original timestamp retained, no intraday execution claim
primary_comparison.changed_factor: financial fact vintage; primary comparison preserves the A-arm missingness mask
primary_comparison.cohort_rule: Define eligibility using A-time information only; never require availability of a later report. If no later comparable value exists, B retains A. Initially missing facts remain missing in both primary arms.
primary_comparison.primary_estimand: paired difference in average precision over annual-filing prediction observations within each held-out time block
primary_comparison.ranking_scope: Retrospective diagnostic rankings within each test time block; not an implementable simultaneous screening policy. Any operational claim requires a separately defined common calendar-landmark risk set.
primary_comparison.event_counting: One original annual report per CIK and fiscal interval; amendments are versions, not new landmarks. Report both positive filing-window observations and distinct linked group-case episodes. A case may appear in multiple legitimate windows; filing-window recall is not unique-event recall. A future event-level measure must deduplicate alerts by group-case and retain earliest eligible alert.

time_blocks: Three successive held-out calendar blocks, boundaries selected from availability and event counts before any model results; not yet fixed
planned_fits_if_gate_passes: 2 models x 2 vintages x 3 time blocks = 12, plus 3 prevalence-only baselines; hyperparameter selection costs additional and must be logged
uncertainty: Paired enterprise-group cluster resampling within held-out time blocks, plus separate block estimates; sparse-event resamples without events counted as undefined. No claim that three blocks identify macroeconomic uncertainty.

resource_policy.note: Budget is a pilot limit, not an estimate for the full SEC population. Reassess from file counts and observed sizes before expansion.

stop_or_redesign: No credible historical risk set or outcome ascertainment
Standard-tag coverage failures select only easily observed survivors or events
Paired value differences cannot be separated from different periods, units or accounting scope
Only a few anecdotes with no measurable implication for the fixed decision task
Effects too imprecise to distinguish operationally relevant differences
independent_design_review: 2026-09-21: addressed later-vintage availability selection, asynchronous ranking versus operational capacity, and repeated event counting. Data gate still not passed.
